evals.setup: A vault with one ingested source (a Fisman and Wei style trade-gap paper) and the concept page regression-coefficient.
evals.prompt: /cognia:explainer fisman-wei-2004-tax-evasion-china regression-coefficient. Build the concept explainer for regression-coefficient.

expectations.text: The explainer passes the static lint with zero failures
The file is named <slug>-regression-coefficient-explainer.html under writing/
No figure only restates its screen heading
Every file name follows the naming rules

evals.setup: A vault with one source ingested at Skim depth and its worksheet.

expectations.text: The explainer passes the static lint with zero failures
writing/**/<slug>-explainer.html exists

evals.setup: A vault with a source whose worksheet holds a regression equation (gap_i = alpha + beta_1 tax_i + u_i, slide 9).
evals.prompt: /cognia:explainer fisman-wei-2004-tax-evasion-china semi-elasticity. Build the concept explainer; the regression on slide 9 must be on it.

expectations.text: The explainer passes the static lint with zero failures
The regression is a .equation block with data-src and a .where list
No equation is written inline in a paragraph
The equation's data-src names slide 9

evals.setup: A vault with one ingested source and its worksheet.

expectations.text: The essay passes the static lint with zero failures
The equation is $$ ... $$ followed by Where: and a (Source: ...) line
The essay has one xychart-beta with both axis titles
The file is <slug>-essay.md
